entities.summary: Narges Mohammadi is an Iranian human rights activist and Nobel Peace Prize laureate. She has been imprisoned in Iran for several periods since 2016. She is back in prison after receiving a sentence of seven and a half years on 8 February 2026, but has had several health issues in recent years.
